segments.text: One live request crosses four governed surfaces: Functions, API Management, ACA Sandbox, and Application Insights.

This is the deployed Hosted Skills chat UI. The prompt asks Microsoft Learn MCP for grounding, then asks the model to issue two independent local shell calls in parallel. The tool counter reaches three before the answer returns both safe markers. Model fan-out is parallel; the shared sandbox queues local execution through its file journal so isolation and ordering remain deterministic.

The run created one fresh sandbox in two point nine four seconds. Both shell commands stayed in that sandbox. Cleanup handoff took sixty-five point nine milliseconds, delete succeeded in one point six eight seconds, and typed inventory is now zero.

This is the same live run from its Application Insights spans, not a generic trace. The thirty point nine five second hybrid invocation includes sandbox creation, a four point five five second model planning call, a six hundred twenty-three millisecond Microsoft Learn tool call, two local journal executions, a two point eight two second synthesis call, and cleanup. Sixty-eight dependency spans preserve the relationship while prompt text, tool arguments, results, and sandbox identifiers stay out of telemetry.

The same UTC window shows two successful model posts and five successful MCP posts through the AI Gateway. The live policies enforce backend routing, token governance, rate limits, streaming, W three C correlation, and zero body capture.

For this demo app, the live request returned HTTP two hundred in thirty-one seconds and inventory returned to zero. Across twenty-one optimized qualification runs, create averaged three point zero one seconds, upload one hundred thirty-five milliseconds, readiness three hundred thirty-three milliseconds, and runtime fell forty-eight percent with zero request errors.
Functions orchestrates. API Management governs. ACA Sandbox isolates. Application Insights proves the flow: live, end to end, and cleaned up.
